name: Mozilla Observatory
tagline: HTTP security header and best-practice scanning for websites
description: Mozilla Observatory analyzes websites for security best practices, focusing on HTTP security headers, TLS configuration, and related hardening signals. Developers use its API to scan sites, retrieve grade/score results, and track security posture over time.

auth.details: No authentication required for public scan and result endpoints.

use_cases: scan a website for HTTP security header issues
retrieve Mozilla Observatory grade and score for a host
check whether a site enables HSTS, CSP, or related headers
monitor security posture of domains over time
